title: What Sponge Cities 2.0 Is
definition: Sponge Cities 2.0: cities that drink floodwater and exhale cool air.

title: The Signature Vision: Sponge Cities 2.0
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Sponge Cities 2.0.
description:
The Signature vision of Sponge Cities 2.0 does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature sponge hulls program, charter one: master wetland districts at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale water transit manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate permeable grids systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Sponge Cities 2.0 becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

Builders sequence this piece early because every other component assumes it works. In the Signature architecture this piece is designed first-class, not bolted on.

t: 2030 — The first sponge hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first sponge hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Sponge Cities 2.0 roadmap.
description:
The first sponge hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its wetland districts grid and water transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the wetland districts results have to replicate outside the lab, water transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and permeable grids operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed wetland districts demonstrations, water transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting permeable grids uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Sponge Cities 2.0
definition: Estimates Sponge Cities 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Sponge Cities 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a sponge hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Sponge Cities 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Sponge Cities 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Sponge Cities 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 71915 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where wetland districts monitoring, water transit redundancy, or permeable grids maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Sponge Cities 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sponge Cities 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sponge Cities 2.0 — cities that drink floodwater and exhale cool air.

Phase 1 — Prove (wetland districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (water transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (permeable grids): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (rain blocks): sponge hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and river basins-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
